summary: HQ / ownership: Burnaby, BC; founded 1984; acquired by Volaris Group (Constellation Software) — reported Apr 29, 2025 as a deal "widely missed last year by local media," i.e. it likely closed in 2024
On-premises and cloud POS for full-service restaurants, multi-unit chains, hotels, resorts and casinos; claims the first touchscreen restaurant POS (1984)
Constellation/Volaris typically runs acquired software for cash flow (low reinvestment)
Jason Leeson — President from Dec 2015 (under prior owner Marin Investments); current leader after the Volaris deal: not found
